tagline: Global leader in advanced filtration products for commercial and off-highway vehicles
hero_kpi_rationale: Aftermarket represents 86% of net sales in 2025, providing a stable and predictable base of recurring revenue, a key element of the company's business model in a cyclically sensitive demand environment.

kpis.name: Aftermarket Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of net sales derived from the sale of filtration products for vehicles and equipment already in operation
kpis.description: Aftermarket accounted for 86% of the company's net sales in 2025, generating a robust base of recurring revenue

kpis.name: First-fit Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of net sales derived from the sale of filtration products for new vehicles and equipment
kpis.description: The first-fit market represented 14% of net sales in 2025, with reduced demand due to depressed market conditions

kpis.name: Aftermarket Revenue Mix 2025
kpis.explanation: Share of net sales from replacement filtration products for vehicles and equipment already in operation
kpis.description: Aftermarket represented 86% of the company's net sales in 2025, while first-fit generated 14%, reflecting the company's reliance on replacement parts demand
kpis.signal: Aftermarket generates the majority of net sales and provides a base of recurring revenue

risks.title: Major customer concentration (Cummins, PACCAR, Traton)
risks.score_rationale: This risk is listed first in the 'Risks Related to Our Business Operations' section and the language intensity is high ('material and adverse effect'). It represents a significant portion of sales and the loss of a major customer would have an existential impact.

risks.title: Technological transition toward electrification
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed and positioned as a major challenge for future growth. The language intensity ('could result in lower demand', 'reduce or eliminate the demand') indicates high severity in the context of a major energy transition.

risks.title: Dependence on revenues from unconsolidated entities
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified in 'Risks Related to Our Business Operations' and its potential impact is qualified as 'material adverse effect'. The significant share of revenues from these entities justifies high severity.

risks.title: Competitive intensity and innovation
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described with notable intensity ('significant competition', 'risk losing business', 'no guarantee that we will be successful'). The need for continuous investment and uncertainty of returns justify high severity.

risks.title: Supply chain and cost risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned with moderate intensity but covers several critical aspects ('Variability in material and commodity costs', 'Interruptions in the supply of critical materials and components', 'Complexity of supply chain and manufacturing'). The impact on operations is direct.

risks.title: Attracting and retaining qualified personnel
risks.score_rationale: This risk is qualified as 'critical to our success' and the inability to attract or retain personnel is deemed capable of having 'material adverse effects'. Dependence on technical personnel is emphasized.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data security risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified in a dedicated section ('Risks Related to Cybersecurity and Information Technology Infrastructure') and the potential impact ('system or data security breaches or other disruptions') is significant, although the language intensity is lower than for major operational risks.

risks.title: Indebtedness and capital structure
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the 'Risks Related to Atmus Capital Structure' section and mentions the potential impact on the ability to service debt ('may impact Atmus' ability to service all its indebtedness'). The presence of pledged assets increases the risk.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents
